fix(ace-worker): inject cudatoolkit LD_LIBRARY_PATH for missing nvrtc/curand

Worker bundle ships cudart+cublas but not libnvrtc.so.12 or libcurand.so.10.
The loader appends parent LD_LIBRARY_PATH to the subprocess env — so setting
it in the systemd service via extraEnv covers the missing libs on WSL2.

feat: add load-ai-keys command for manual secrets loading

Change SOPS secrets to manual loading instead of automatic:

- Remove automatic _load_sops_secrets call on shell startup
- Add convenient 'load-ai-keys' command for on-demand loading
- Keep sops_source_env() available for project .env.enc files

fix: ensure Nix is available in PATH for all repos

Major shell configuration cleanup and fixes:

**Critical Fix:**
- Move Nix PATH setup AFTER mise activation in bashrc
- Fixes direnv/Nix integration across all repositories
- Ensures `nix` command is always available system-wide

**Shell Simplification:**
- Reduce bashrc from 287 to 53 lines
- Remove complex SOPS auto-loading (caused startup hangs)
- Remove process cleanup hooks (killed Claude Code processes)
- Remove Zellij auto-attach (caused WSL freezing)
- Simplify bash profile for faster login

**SOPS Management:**
- Add SOPS_USAGE.md documentation
- Add sops-env script for manual secret loading
- Restructure secrets: api-keys.yaml (new format)
- Remove corrupted/backup secret files

**Other Changes:**
- Update starship and zellij configs
- Add ZSH cleanup module
- Update flake.nix with latest dependencies
- Clean up .sops.yaml configuration

This fixes the "nix: command not found" error affecting
all repositories when using direnv.
